# naizo.js

> Self-persisting HTML built-in database (`#naizodb`) and declarative list repeater (`[naizo-list]`) for Human + AI Agent workflows. Turns any single `.html` file (dashboards, interactive studios, personal trackers, design option labs, calculators, visual canvases, engineering notebooks, plans, specs, checklists, triage boards, and custom micro-tools) into a living, self-saving application whose state syncs between the browser DOM, `localStorage`, and `<script id="naizodb" type="application/json">` on disk. Zero dependencies, ~28.0 KB minified + gzipped / 94.8 KB raw (~41.6 KB gzipped / ~185.3 KB raw readable), MIT License.

In Japanese, **naizō (ないぞう)** means both **内蔵 (built-in / housed within)** and **内臓 (internal organs)**: `<script id="naizodb">` is the built-in JSON database inside `<head>`, and `naizo.js` provides the reactive internal organs that bind inputs, repeat lists, and sync human browser edits with AI agent disk edits.

## Core Authoring Contract (9 Universal Golden Rules)

1. **`<body>` is the template; `<script id="naizodb">` is the canonical data (`D16`, `D19`, `D20`, `D59`, `EC09`, `EC46`, `EC58`–`EC61`):**
   - Place `<script id="naizodb" type="application/json">` at the top of `<head>` initialized with `{ "_meta": {}, "fields": {}, "lists": {}, "custom": {} }` (2-space indented, `<` escaped as `\u003c`), and load `naizo.js` (`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/naizojs@latest/dist/naizo.js`, `dist/naizo.min.js`, `unpkg`, local `./dist/naizo.js`, or latest in-development `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nickosh/naizo@main/dist/naizo.js`) with `defer`.
   - Prefer a single authored `<template naizo-template>` with `0` duplicated static `[naizo-item]` shells in `<body>` for multi-item/card lists.
   - To read human edits from disk, parse `<script id="naizodb">` (skipping `<!-- ... -->` HTML comments, `EC60`). To update data on disk, surgically rewrite only `<script id="naizodb">` (`createWritable()` is skipped on no-op writes to preserve `mtime`, `EC59`). Open linked tabs merge external edits across top-level keys and **per list item** via a two-tier `O(N)` 3-way list merge (Path A: unique primitive `item.id` `string | number` across additions/deletions/reorders/live per-property edits without compulsory UUIDs `D19`, backing up collisions via `hasCollision` to `naizodb_backup_<key>` + `↺ Restore`; Path B: conservative aligned-prefix `0 .. base.length - 1` edits + appends for `id`-less checklists, backed by compact per-item FNV-1a hashes in `naizodb_disk_hash_<key>`, `EC58`), reconcile `[naizo-item]` DOM nodes in place across length changes preserving `document.activeElement` focus/caret (`EC58`), and pause writes on live broken disk JSON (`Invalid #naizodb JSON` + `naizodb_raw_backup_<key>` + `4. Repair JSON`, auto-recovering when fixed on disk, `EC59`). Account for per-key/item 3-way FNV-1a merge (`naizodb_disk_hash_<key>`) when testing unlinked `localStorage` pages (`↺ Reset` / `Naizo.reset()`).
2. **Preserve pass-through keys (`D15`) & treat `Naizo.get()` / `Naizo.getList()` as fast read-only views (`D59`, `EC14`, `EC61`):** Unbound keys in `fields`, unbound arrays in `lists`, and extra properties/sub-arrays on list item objects (`"id"`, `"estimate"`, `"updatedAt"`, `"slots"`) pass through untouched via `WeakMap` row bindings (`itemDataMap` resolves `×` / `↑ ↓` by row identity before DOM index, and multiple `[naizo-list="name"]` containers stay synchronized across all list operations, `EC61`). `Naizo.get()` and `Naizo.getList()` return `O(1)` uncloned/unfrozen live references (`< 0.5 ms`) — never mutate returned objects/arrays directly; render rich HTML (`<a>`, Markdown, badges) into `[naizo-ignore]` containers and mutate via `Naizo.set*`, `updateItem`, `addItem`, `setList`, or `batch`.
3. **Explicit binding, plain-text leaves (`EC19`, `EC56`), & `naizo-ignore` vs. `naizo-strip` (`D08`, `D22`, `D47`):** Bind exclusively with `naizo="key"` / `data-naizo="key"` and `naizo-list="name"` + `naizo-item`. Plain `<span naizo="key">` / `<h3 naizo="key">` leaves live-mirror sibling interactive controls via `textContent` (never mutate their `innerHTML`, and interactive controls seed ahead of passive leaves regardless of DOM order). Use `naizo-ignore` for custom UI kept on export and `naizo-strip` for transient/hosted-only elements stripped on `exportHTML()` / `⬇ Save to PC`.
4. **Safe form controls inside `[naizo-item]` (`EC15`, `EC39`, `EC55`):** Wrap `<label>` around inputs (never duplicate `for`/`id` across rows), include `<option value="">— Select… —</option>` on nullable `<select>` controls (`""`/`null` renders `selectedIndex = -1` without warning), and remember `<select>` always stores `string` values (use `<input type="checkbox">` for booleans, never raw boolean `false` on `<select>`).
5. **Scope documents with `<html naizo-id="slug">` (`D13`, `EC11`):** Prevents `localStorage` and IndexedDB handle collisions across multiple tools on `localhost` or `file://`.
6. **Non-destructive filtering (`row.hidden`) & single-pass list replacement (`Naizo.setList`, `D43`):** Toggle `row.hidden = !matches` (never remove `[naizo-item]` DOM nodes to filter) and call `Naizo.setList(name, items)` (or `Naizo.setList(name, [])`) for bulk updates/clears.
7. **Status Pill visibility (`naizo-no-pill`), initial corner (`naizo-pill-corner`), & toast clearance (`D50`, `D56`, `D57`, `EC53`):** Only add `naizo-no-pill` / `data-naizo-no-pill` when the user asks to hide the Status Pill or build a custom persistence toolbar; when doing so in Local Mode, surface `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` or a `<button type="button" onclick="Naizo.link()">Link Disk</button>` (`await Naizo.link()`) control so users can still persist data to `<script id="naizodb">` on disk. Place app toasts at `top-right` or `bottom-center`, or set `naizo-pill-corner="bottom-left"` (`data-naizo-pill-corner`) when `bottom-right` hosts fixed app controls.
8. **Boot timing: top-level `naizo:hydrate` / `Naizo.ready()`, idempotent `[naizo-ignore]` enhancements, & clean `"theme": "system"` (`D45`, `EC48`, `EC57`):** Never wrap `naizo:hydrate` registration inside `DOMContentLoaded` when loading `<script defer>` (attach at top level or call `Naizo.ready(syncUi)`), keep `[naizo-ignore]` enhancements idempotent, align static `hidden` attributes with initial `#naizodb` defaults, and follow author styling preferences first (falling back to calm Washi Editorial minimalism `#faf8f5` light / `#141311` dark with `"theme": "system"` + CSS `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` so initial load never calls `Naizo.setField()` or dirties `initialDiskDb`).
9. **Batch mutations (`Naizo.batch`), non-reentrant `naizo:change`, `dataset.slotSignature` memoization, & commit-time `'change'` derivations (`D57`, `EC54`):** Use `Naizo.batch(fn, options?)` for multi-item/cross-scope updates (`{ silent: true }` for silent derived writes, `{ deferPersist: true }` for 60fps range/canvas scrubs), memoize `[naizo-ignore]` subtrees via `dataset.slotSignature`, and attach delegated native `'change'` listeners (never `naizo:change`, which fires on `input`) for commit-time `name → slug` derivations.

## Declarative HTML Attributes (`naizo` / `data-naizo`)

- `naizo="key"` / `data-naizo="key"` – Bind element state to `db.fields["key"]` (or `item["key"]` inside/on `[naizo-item]`), including live `textContent` mirroring on passive `<span>`/`<h3>` leaves (`EC19`, `EC56`) and `selectedIndex = -1` on blank single `<select>` controls (`EC55`).
- `naizo-list="name"` / `data-naizo-list="name"` – Bind direct `[naizo-item]` children to `db.lists["name"]` (keeping multiple `[naizo-list="name"]` containers synchronized, `EC61`) and inject `+ Add Item`.
- `naizo-item` / `data-naizo-item` – Repeating list row/card (reconciled in place across length changes preserving `document.activeElement` focus/caret, `EC58`) with hover `↑ ↓ ×` controls and `WeakMap` pass-through keys.
- `naizo-template` / `data-naizo-template` – Explicit `<template>` blueprint inside `[naizo-list]` (auto-inferred from first item when omitted).
- `naizo-add="name"` / `data-naizo-add="name"` – Button that appends a blank item to `[naizo-list="name"]`.
- `naizo-remove` / `data-naizo-remove` – Button inside `[naizo-item]` that deletes the row (`WeakMap` row identity before DOM index, `EC61`).
- `naizo-move="up|down"` / `data-naizo-move="up|down"` – Button inside `[naizo-item]` that moves the row up or down (`WeakMap` row identity before DOM index, `EC61`).
- `naizo-no-controls` / `data-naizo-no-controls` – Suppress auto-injected `+ Add Item` and row toolbars on `[naizo-list]`.
- `naizo-ignore` / `data-naizo-ignore` – Exclude element/subtree from state binding while preserving it in exported HTML.
- `naizo-strip` / `data-naizo-strip` – Exclude element/subtree from state binding and strip it from auto-templates and exported/downloaded HTML (`⬇ Save to PC`).
- `naizo-id="scope"` / `data-naizo-id="scope"` – Scope `localStorage` and IndexedDB keys (`<path>::<scope>`).
- `naizo-mode="online|local|auto"` / `data-naizo-mode="online|local|auto"` – Override Local Mode vs. Online Mode detection.
- `naizo-pill-corner="bottom-right|bottom-left|top-right|top-left"` / `data-naizo-pill-corner` – Set initial Status Pill corner on `<body>` or `<html>` (`<body>` overrides `<html>`, preserved on export; user drag saved in `naizodb_ui_<key>` takes priority).
- `naizo-no-pill` / `data-naizo-no-pill` – Skip mounting `#__naizodb_host__` (`<body>` overrides `<html>`, and `="false"` opts out) while retaining `#__naizodb_styles__`, `localStorage`, live disk sync, and `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` (preserved on export; logs `console.warn` on malformed startup `#naizodb` JSON).
- `naizo-manual` / `data-naizo-manual` – Disable automatic `initNaizo()` boot.
- `naizo-get="url"` / `data-naizo-get="url"` – Fetch JSON/text via `GET` and route `2xx` responses via `naizo-into` (or hydrate `#naizodb` when `naizo-into` is omitted).
- `naizo-post="url"` / `data-naizo-post="url"` – Flush pending edits and send a CORS-safelisted `text/plain;charset=UTF-8` JSON `POST` payload (fire-and-forget unless `naizo-into` is set).
- `naizo-into="target"` / `data-naizo-into="target"` – Route response into `field:<key>`, `list:<name>` (`Naizo.setList`), `custom:<key>`, `db` (backing up non-empty `store` to `naizodb_backup_<key>` before replacement, `EC59`), or a DOM-only `#selector` (`textContent`, never `innerHTML`, skipping `[naizo-ignore]` / `[naizo-strip]` subtrees, `EC50`).
- `naizo-path="a.b.0"` / `data-naizo-path="a.b.0"` – Extract nested JSON values via `Object.hasOwn()` dot-path traversal.
- `naizo-body="source"` / `data-naizo-body="source"` – Select outgoing `POST` payload (`db`, `fields`, `custom`, `list:<name>`, or `field:<key>`).
- `naizo-trigger="click|init|load"` / `data-naizo-trigger="click|init|load"` – Fire request on `click` (default), `init` (boot only when target is empty), or `load` (every boot).
- `naizo-cors="no-cors"` / `data-naizo-cors="no-cors"` – Enable opaque fire-and-forget webhook `POST` delivery when `naizo-into` is omitted.
- **Intentionally omitted widget directives (`D57`, `D58`):** `naizo.js` omits `naizo-tab` / `naizo-panel`, nested `naizo-list`, `naizo-text`, `naizo-href`, `naizo-index`, `naizo-options`, `naizo-autocreate-option`, `naizo-lazy`, and `[naizo-cloak]` – see `/llms-full.txt` and `/SKILL.md` for copy-ready native HTML5 patterns (`radio` + `:has(:checked)` tabs, `D15` sub-arrays + `dataset.slotSignature`, 60fps coupled `<input type="range">` sliders, `<datalist>`, `<template naizo-template>.content` option sync, and delegated native `'change'`).

## Programmatic API (`window.Naizo` / `window.NaizoDB`)

- Custom bucket (`db.custom`): `Naizo.get(key?)` (`O(1)` uncloned/unfrozen read-only live view — never mutate directly; `D59`), `Naizo.set(key, value)`, `Naizo.delete(key)`
- Fields bucket (`db.fields`): `Naizo.getField(key)`, `Naizo.setField(key, value)`, `Naizo.deleteField(key)`
- Lists bucket (`db.lists`): `Naizo.getList(name)` (`O(1)` uncloned/unfrozen read-only live view — mutate via mutators below; `D59`), `Naizo.setList(name, items)`, `Naizo.addItem(name, data?)`, `Naizo.updateItem(name, index, partial)`, `Naizo.moveItem(name, from, to)`, `Naizo.removeItem(name, index)`
- Batching & Boot Readiness (`M13.1`, `D57`): `Naizo.batch(fn, options?)` (`{ silent?: boolean; deferPersist?: boolean }`, nestable synchronous DOM updates + coalesced persistence/`'batch'` event), `Naizo.ready(callback)` (runs synchronously if already hydrated, or once on boot `'naizo:hydrate'`)
- Mini-API Client, Lifecycle & Export: `await Naizo.fetch(url, options?)` (omit `options.into` to return parsed `data` without mutating `#naizodb`, `D52`), `Naizo.bind(root?)` (skips persistence on no-op seed, `EC59`), `await Naizo.save()` (skips `createWritable()` when on-disk `#naizodb` matches, preserving `mtime`, `EC59`), `Naizo.reset()`, `await Naizo.link()` (URL-decoded `suggestedName` + rename-friendly wrong-file link guard on non-empty conflicting `#naizodb` files, `EC60`), `await Naizo.unlink()`, `await Naizo.copyJSON()`, `Naizo.exportHTML()`, `Naizo.downloadHTML(filename?)`
- Events on `window`: `'naizo:hydrate'`, `'naizo:change'` (non-reentrant FIFO queue capped at 10 passes; `e.detail` `{ scope, action, source: 'dom' | 'api', list?, key?, index?, fromIndex?, toIndex?, value?, db }`, including `action: 'update'` + `index` on `[naizo-item]` DOM edits, `fromIndex` + `toIndex` on `moveItem`, `scope: 'restore'` on `Restore Backup` / `Repair JSON`, and `{ scope: 'batch', action: 'batch', source: 'api', db }`), `'naizo:item'`, `'naizo:fetch'`
- Status Pill, Action Buttons (`1..6`), `#dot` Logo States, Browser Matrix, & Network Rules (`#net`, `D43`, `D50`, `D51`, `D52`, `D56`, `D57`, `D59`, `EC02`, `EC04`, `EC48`, `EC59`–`EC61`): Translucent frosted-glass pill (`#__naizodb_host__`) with FLIP 4-corner snap drag persisted in `naizodb_ui_<key>` (defaulting to `naizo-pill-corner` or `bottom-right`), leftmost `20px` _Maru ni Mitsuishi_ (`丸に三つ石` / `品`) `#dot` crest (Green `#10b981` `saved`/`saving`, Amber `#f59e0b` `cached`/`needs-permission`/`conflict`, Red `#ef4444` `error`; 5 motion states including `Saving Heartbeat` with `1.55s` cycle completion and `Conflict Clash`), strict `1..6` circular icon buttons (`1. Link Disk / Unlink Disk` swapping in Slot 1, `2. Save to PC`, `3. Copy JSON / ✓ Copied`, `4. Repair JSON` Wrench to rebuild startup or live linked-disk malformed `#naizodb` JSON backed up in `naizodb_raw_backup_<key>` without silent data loss—also auto-recovering when fixed on disk, `5. Restore Backup` History Clock-Undo, `6. Reset to Initial State` Red Eraser available in both Online Mode and unlinked Local Mode `!fileHandle` whenever `localStorage` diverges from `initialDiskDb`, auto-hiding once linked to disk), and auto-shown rightmost `#net` wired-globe (`API idle`, `API active` `L→R` wave held `>= 600 ms`, `API request failed` persistent red pulse until clicked or page reload – inspect failed requests in the browser DevTools `Network` tab; no built-in inspector) without altering `#dot`/`#status`; Local Mode live disk sync works out of the box in **Chrome/Edge/Arc/Opera** (the initial OS Save dialog asks _"Replace?"_ once to confirm in-place write access), via `brave://flags/#file-system-access-api` in **Brave**, and via `localStorage` + `.html` download + `📋 Copy JSON` in **Safari/Firefox** (open via `file://` or plain non-watching `python3 -m http.server` / `npx serve`; avoid file-watching live-reload dev servers like `Vite`, `VS Code Live Server`, and `BrowserSync`), persisting fetched state surgically to `#naizodb` on disk (`file://` `Origin: null` needs `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` or `naizo-cors="no-cors"` and blocks relative `./data.json`); Online Mode supports relative `./preset.json` and bakes fetched state into `⬇ Save to PC` (blocking mixed `http://` and requiring `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true` for `localhost`).

## AI Agent & LLM Documentation Endpoints

- [Complete Single-File Documentation & Templates (`/llms-full.txt`)](https://naizo.js.org/llms-full.txt): Full authoring guide, 9 Golden Rules, HTML5 UI patterns `(a)`–`(g)`, API reference, surgical disk-edit script, and starter HTML templates in one file.
- [Installable AI Agent Skill (`/SKILL.md`)](https://naizo.js.org/SKILL.md): Distributable skill for Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and Gemini CLI (`gh skill install nickosh/naizo naizo` or `npx skills add nickosh/naizo --skill naizo`, bundling `references/cookbook/*.md`; for experimental in-development `main`, pair `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nickosh/naizo@main/dist/naizo.js` with `gh skill install nickosh/naizo naizo@main` or `npx skills add nickosh/naizo@main --skill naizo`).
- Progressive-Disclosure Cookbook Guides (`/references/cookbook/`, load on demand only when relevant):
  - [Basecoat UI, Dense Multi-Column Forms, & `<dialog>` Modals](https://naizo.js.org/references/cookbook/basecoat-ui-and-dense-forms.md)
  - [Third-Party Runtime DOM Libraries & Clean HTML Export (`naizo-strip` vs. `naizo-ignore`)](https://naizo.js.org/references/cookbook/third-party-dom-and-export.md)
  - [`file://`-Portable Interactive Maps & Multi-Provider Live APIs](https://naizo.js.org/references/cookbook/maps-and-live-apis.md)
  - [Animated SVG Craft, UI Motion, Procedural Web Audio, & Modular Avatars](https://naizo.js.org/references/cookbook/audio-motion-and-svg-avatars.md)
  - [CSV Ingestion, Slack/Sheets Exporters, CLI Pipelines, & Playwright Testing](https://naizo.js.org/references/cookbook/data-ingestion-export-and-testing.md)
- [Interactive Documentation & Live Playground (`/`)](https://naizo.js.org/): Self-persisting `naizo.js` documentation site and live `#naizodb` inspector.

## Starter App Blueprints

- [Project Specification & Milestones (`/examples/starter.html`)](https://naizo.js.org/examples/starter.html): Minimal spec sheet with editable title, owner/status fields, summary textarea, and milestone repeater.
- [Release Verification Checklist (`/examples/checklist.html`)](https://naizo.js.org/examples/checklist.html): Pre-release sign-off sheet with reviewer metadata, environment selector, readiness toggle, and prioritized checks.
- [Master–Detail Engineering Notebook (`/examples/notes.html`)](https://naizo.js.org/examples/notes.html): Zero-DOM-wipe multi-note workspace on `[naizo-list="notes"]` with sidebar search, persisted category filter, pinning, live word/task counters, and `Alt+N` / `Alt+↑/↓` navigation.
- [Asset & Inventory Studio (`/examples/inventory.html`)](https://naizo.js.org/examples/inventory.html): Filterable card grid with custom per-card pass-through JSON keys, `<dialog>` modals, and live KPI summaries.
- [Outing & Weather Route Planner (`/examples/weather.html`)](https://naizo.js.org/examples/weather.html): Interactive OpenLayers topo/satellite/GSI map, multi-provider hourly weather forecast cards with day-to-night sky slider, persisted `[naizo-list="route"]` itinerary, and declarative `naizo-get` / `naizo-post` webhook sync.
- [GitHub Repository (`nickosh/naizo`)](https://github.com/nickosh/naizo): Source code, tests, and full usage reference (`docs/USAGE.md`).
